clue.text: Empty honour for a woodwind player

indicators.note: read loosely here as making room for, so the empty letter is set inside the honour

parts.note: the OBE is a British honour, Officer of the Order of the British Empire
empty suggests nothing, the round letter O

explanation.surface: A worthless award handed to a musician in the woodwind section.
explanation.walkthrough: The OBE (Order of the British Empire) is a British honour; O, a nought, sits inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of a reed instrument also serves for the musician in an orchestra who plays it.

clue.text: Company with deficit states large figure

parts.note: a deficit is a shortfall, a loss
the States, the USA, abbreviated US

explanation.surface: A firm in the red reports its figures, or a company's statement about a big loss.
explanation.definitionFit: A colossus is a gigantic statue, like the one that stood at Rhodes, so a huge figure.

clue.text: Three-speed gears give one the advantage

indicators.note: the words give up, or yield, a run of their own letters spanning speed and gears

explanation.surface: A bicycle with three gears lets its rider get ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: To have the edge over someone is to hold a slight advantage over them.

clue.text: Servant's pay for help when needed

definitions.meaning: an old-fashioned word for a household servant of long standing
a fee paid in advance to keep a lawyer or adviser available to call on

explanation.surface: A household helper's wages, paid whenever help is required.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from retaining: keeping a servant in the house, or keeping an adviser on call by a fee.

indicators.note: first says the word for appeared comes before the painter

parts.note: appeared means came, as in turned up
RA, a Royal Academician, is the stock crossword painter

explanation.surface: Painting came first and the photographic device came after it in history.
explanation.walkthrough: RA stands for Royal Academician, a member of London's Royal Academy of Arts.
explanation.definitionFit: Photography, through this device, arrived long after painting as a way of making pictures.

clue.text: Ride in which first part is shorter than the second

definitions.text: Ride in which first part is shorter than the second

parts.words: Ride in which first part is shorter than the second
parts.note: a fairground carousel; the joke is that its first half, ROUND, has five letters like its second, so the claim is playful, or that a ride round is shorter than going about

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a fairground ride whose first leg is shorter than the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A merry-go-round at a fair is known in Britain by this name, and it takes riders in circles.

definitions.meaning: a cigar made in Cuba is named after its capital

explanation.definitionFit: Cuba's capital city lends its name to the famous cigars rolled there.

clue.text: See head of finance over charges

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter
over here means turned over, so the word for see is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Consult the finance chief about the prices being charged.
explanation.definitionFit: Fees are charges made for a service, such as a lawyer's or a school's.

clue.text: It's kept in banks but also found in circulation

definitions.text: It's kept in banks but also found in circulation

parts.words: It's kept in banks but also found in circulation
parts.note: banks suggests money, but ... banks store it and it flows round the circulatory system

explanation.definitionFit: Donated red fluid is stored in hospital banks, and the body pumps it round in its circulation.

definitions.meaning: lavish and intricate, as an adjective
as a verb, to embellish or add detail to

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means ornate or lavish; as a verb, to add details or embellishment.

parts.note: looks like costing nothing, but means to clear someone of a criminal accusation

explanation.definitionFit: To clear a defendant of an accusation is literally to free them of the charge against them.

indicators.note: a distribution spreads the letters out into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone advocates a more sensible way of sharing things out.
explanation.definitionFit: To approach something is to draw close to it, a verb synonym in the same form.

clue.text: Don't vote for a black mark

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
a stain is a mark or blemish

explanation.surface: A voter told not to back a candidate with a black mark against them.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain is to decline to cast a vote at all, an imperative matching the clue's command.

definitions.meaning: sailors are often out on the water, away from land
bewildered or lost, as in the idiom for being baffled

explanation.definitionFit: Literally out on the water like sailors, and idiomatically bewildered and lost.

clue.text: French friend with talent and charm

parts.note: ami is French for friend
a talent is an ability or gift

explanation.surface: A French companion who is both gifted and charming.
explanation.definitionFit: Friendliness and pleasantness of manner make up the kind of charm meant here.

clue.text: Female confronts male, beginning to threaten firm

parts.note: Ada is a woman's name
a man is a male

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A woman faces down a threatening man and holds her ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone firm in a view refuses to be moved from it, an adjective synonym.

indicators.note: the answer reads the same when mirrored, backwards as forwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A conviction that survives careful thought without alteration.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or doctrine held as true, a direct synonym.

clue.text: American tucked into his cooked fish and rice dish

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, like food tucked into a wrap
cooked means altered or rearranged, so the letters of his are shuffled

parts.note: US is short for American, as in the US

explanation.surface: An American tucks into a plate of fish and rice someone cooked for him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' signals the anagram making SHI; 'tucked into' looks like eating, but it is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Japanese dish combines vinegared rice with raw or cooked fish.

clue.text: Regret expressed in the French way

definitions.meaning: the French word for a street, a way

explanation.surface: Sorrow voiced with Gallic flair.
explanation.definitionFit: In English it means to be sorry for; in French it is a street or roadway.

parts.note: one word covers both the light let onto film and dangerous chilling from being left out in the cold

explanation.definitionFit: Photographers set the amount of light on film this way, and the same word names harm from cold weather.

indicators.note: from signals the letters are made from the word canoe in a new order

explanation.surface: Waves are coming at you from a canoe.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea, poetically the waves, is the open water of the deep.

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Time taken as a whole, possibly.
explanation.definitionFit: Endless time without beginning or end, a grand sense of the word for time.

clue.text: A loud story, not factual but friendly

parts.note: f, forte, is the musical marking for loud
a fable is a made-up story, not a true account

explanation.surface: A noisy tale that's invented but amiable.
explanation.definitionFit: Being easy to talk to and good-natured is a close synonym of being friendly.

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other, with the gang enclosed by the iron

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
a ring is a gang, as in a crime ring

explanation.surface: A gang hemmed in by an iron perimeter.
explanation.definitionFit: A fringe is an edge or margin, as at the fringe of a town.

parts.note: tour looks like a sightseeing trip but is French for tower: the engineer who built the famous Paris tower

explanation.definitionFit: Gustave of this surname designed the iron tower in Paris, the Tour of the clue in French.

parts.note: the word describes someone with a complaint, an illness, under a doctor, and also someone who bears things without complaining

explanation.definitionFit: As a noun it is a person with an ailment; as an adjective, uncomplaining and tolerant.

clue.text: It makes a hole in material

explanation.definitionFit: Both a tool for boring holes and a sturdy twilled cotton cloth go by this name.

definitions.meaning: said to seal a deal, meaning it is agreed

explanation.definitionFit: Said on striking a bargain, and meaning finished when something is complete.

indicators.note: something done badly is botched, so the letters come out jumbled

explanation.surface: Discovering a shoe that was poorly constructed.
explanation.definitionFit: Fashioned means shaped or made, a past-participle synonym.

parts.note: the CH is the Order of the Companions of Honour, a British honour

explanation.surface: An instruction to advance carefully, keeping in line.
explanation.walkthrough: CH is the Companion of Honour, a British order.
explanation.definitionFit: To inch forward is to edge along a little at a time, a verb synonym.

definitions.meaning: a legal document signed in front of a witness

explanation.definitionFit: A brave act is a feat, and a signed legal document is valid only with a witness present.

indicators.note: buckles as a verb means bends out of shape, so the letters are twisted round

explanation.surface: A clothing line that comes with buckles.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyjamas and nighties are clothing worn in bed, the garments meant here.

clue.text: Smart girl that is after a share of the proceeds

indicators.note: after places the abbreviation for that is behind the share

parts.note: a cut is a portion of the takings
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A clever woman wants her slice of the takings.
explanation.definitionFit: A cute, attractive young woman, smart in the sense of good-looking, is informally so called.
